_comment: WO-808 Option A (owner-locked 2026-07-30): per-instance gear power levels. Same owned weapon/armor levels up in place; rarity stays identity, level is the power ladder. statMult index 0 = level 1 (always 1.0 = authored baseline). costWood/costIron index N = the cost to REACH level N+1 (index 0 = level 1 = free/owned). WO-855 Phase 6 (2026-08-03) retune: improve costs lifted against the post-faucet-cut economy - rarity ordering preserved, per-level step shape normalized to 1 : 2.5 : 6 : 14, iron = wood/2 throughout. Common stays approachable (first step 90W/45I ~ one early tower); legendary is a genuine chase. NOTE: improve is INSTANT (GearProgression.Improve - no job, no queue channel), so gear costs resources ONLY and never wall-clock; a timed reforge is engine work, not a data tune. Curves are soft placeholders - owner retunes numbers, structure stays. Max level per band = statMult length. DUAL-COPY RULE: Assets/Resources/Data/Canonical is the runtime authority; Assets/StreamingAssets/Data/Canonical must stay byte-identical.
_comment_wo814: WO-814 (owner ruling 2026-08-24, batch 2 ruling 11): reaching a band's MAX level unlocks a special ABILITY on that weapon. PER-RARITY GENERIC, never per-item - per-item authoring scales with the catalog forever. WEAPONS ONLY in this pass; armour rides the mitigation path and is separate engineering, so there is deliberately NO armour ability field here. Row shape mirrors troop-upgrades.json specialAbilities: levelThreshold + abilityId + statusKind + description, plus a display name and the proc knobs (chance / durationSeconds / magnitude). THERE IS DELIBERATELY NO DAMAGE-MULTIPLIER FIELD: the owner's design caution is that a max-level ability must CHANGE PLAYSTYLE (frost slows, fire burns, arcane chains, holy wards) rather than read '+35% more damage', so the data model makes a behaviour expressible and a flat multiplier inexpressible. levelThreshold must be >= 2 and <= the band's statMult length ([gear-levels] oracle pins it). SHIPPED EMPTY ON PURPOSE: the ability IDENTITIES are the owner's creative canon and are authored later by her - the CLI never picks one. Until a row exists the machinery is inert and the Improve preview simply omits the locked line. abilityId resolves against abilities.json via AbilityCatalog.FindById; statusKind is the DeNelle.BattleATB.Engine.StatusKind vocabulary (Burn/Poison/Bleed/Slow/Freeze/Stun/Regen/Haste/Shield/Mark).
